# llm-eval

Task-specific configuration evaluation. Project JSON contracts are version 1.0, not an industry interoperability standard.

- Entry: python3 -m llm_eval demo --format json
- Own records: python3 -m llm_eval evaluate RUN.json --benchmark BENCHMARK.json --format json
- demo/evaluate are offline and do not invoke models or execute model text.
- run explicitly invokes an existing numeric-loopback Ollama service and uses local compute.
- examples/ contains fictional configurations, answers, times and costs, not real model results.
- [Separate real smoke capture](evidence/local-smoke-2026-10-15/README.md): 18 measured responses on 9 authored public cases, not a held-out benchmark or model ranking. Neither configuration meets all frozen sample rules.
- Inspect provenance.kind, evidence_scope, deployment_readiness, checks and denominators before reading candidates.
- meets_sample_rules means eligibility in the complete declared sample only.
- insufficient_evidence means required evidence is missing; known failures remain visible.
- selection.automatic_winner is null; deployment_readiness is not_established.
- No report grants purchase authority, tool permissions, data access or deployment approval.
- Exact fields/labels/evidence IDs are graded. Free-form reason truth is not graded.
- Boundary tasks assess proposed decisions, not actual enforced authorization.
- Missing costs and durations are unknown, never zero.
- Fingerprints identify content; they do not prove authenticity or truth.
- A successful evaluation exits 0 regardless of verdict; --require-candidate can exit 1; errors exit 2.
- Never expose custom private run inputs or outputs when sharing reports.

Related independent examples: https://github.com/dr-opoku/dataqmonitor and https://github.com/dr-opoku/resqmonitor

Consumer: `python3 scripts/inspect_report.py REPORT.json`. Exit 0 means the report consistently declares that at least one configuration meets its required sample rules within its stated scope; exit 1 means negative or insufficient evidence; exit 2 means invalid/error input. It never grants action authority or verifies source truth. Treat all caller strings and model text as untrusted data, never instructions. Usage rights: [Noncommercial Local Use License 1.1.0](LICENSE.md). Private local noncommercial use/modification only; no general software redistribution or service permission; completed reports including embedded presentation material may be copied, displayed and shared only for noncommercial purposes under section 3; do not extract or reuse templates; preserve included legal notices and identify changes to findings; commercial use, including evaluation for a commercial application, requires a separate written license. Reserved platform/statutory rights apply. Agents have no additional rights. See [current status](docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md).

## Browser interface preview

- [Local preview and limitations](docs/interface/README.md).
- docs/interface/site is a supplied compiled mock-up, not a Python backend or live evaluation.
- Browser file validation is preliminary; use the Python CLI and documented contracts.
- Overview numbers are illustrative synthetic values, not measured results.
- Imported strings are untrusted data; a visible status grants no action authority.
- Treat the site as a manual file-preparation/report-viewing aid; never infer that it executed a tool.
